title: Addendum 10: batch 1 of the redo programme (2026-11-05 audit follow-up) - all-author X1-X4, X7 and P1/P2 with five false titles, E4b / all-token probe minus the mean of five false titles
written: 2026-11-05 ~22:20 EST (exact time = sha256 file mtime and git)
approved_by_user: user messages 2026-11-05 evening: 'cells written as limitations that can be redone are all redone'; batch 1 items 1-4 approved as tabled; for item 4, if the five-donor title-reuse exclusion leaves fewer than 1,000 papers, also report a version that excludes only false_0 reuse, side by side.
status_at_writing: Audit (audit_20261105/part_A-C) found: X1-X4 score the first author only (all of that author's name tokens), X2's S_auth was fitted on the first author's first token; X7, P1, P2, E4b and the all-token probe use false_0 only. Published values that must be reproduced are listed per item. No batch-1 data exist.

general rules.order: each new script: tiny-model whole-pipeline test, then one real shard, then the rest
general rules.hard check (user rule for this programme: the new code must reproduce the published number it extends (listed per item) before any further job is submitted. Tolerance: absolute difference <= 0.005 on the reported statistic, or <= 4 bf16 units of the underlying logit where ranks are compared (|logit| 32-64 -> 1.0). A miss stops that item and is reported to the user; other items continue.
general rules.statistics: unchanged from the original item (team-cluster bootstrap 2,000 draws on archived group_folds team ids; same folds, same tune/test split, same layer grids, same prompts and batch sizes)
general rules.helpers: at most 3 helpers at once; results go to the user before any document is changed

1 X1-X4 all authors.change: score EVERY author context of the A paper of each of the 1,178 pairs (tune 596 / test 582), all name tokens (mean log10(1/rank) per author, as score_tf), at the same layers, readouts, partner B and lexical neighbour D as published. Pair-level value = mean over the paper's authors.
1 X1-X4 all authors.primary: the all-author pair-level version of each published X1-X4 statistic, with the same decision rules as the original (X2: addendum 6 H2/H3 rule).
1 X1-X4 all authors.stratification: report every statistic also by author position: first author; other authors (position >= 2); and last author when n_authors >= 3.
1 X1-X4 all authors.X2 subspace: S_auth is refitted on the M3 residual cache with targets built from ALL authors' name tokens (all roles), same k = 10, same training-paper rule and ridge CV as addendum 6; S_id, S_rand (seeds 61-63) and S_full unchanged. Both the old (first-author first-token) and new S_auth are run in the all-author scoring, so the change of subspace and the change of scoring are separable.
1 X1-X4 all authors.hard check: the first-author subset of the new run reproduces the published X1 R curve, X2 table X2.1 (test R_S, R_rand, R_full), X3 behaviour recovery and X4 published values.

2 X7 five false titles.change: knockout runs with false_1..false_4 in addition to false_0 on the same papers, layers and shards.
2 X7 five false titles.decision: the published X7 thresholds are applied to the MEAN over the five false titles (primary); per-title values are reported beside it. The false_0-only published verdict is kept as a reference.
2 X7 five false titles.hard check: the false_0 arm reproduces the published X7 values (control S(L52) = 0.051).

3 P1/P2 five false titles.change: Stage 12 P1 (single-position patching) and P2 (attention vs MLP component patching) on the original Stage 12 sample with donors false_1..false_4 (driver: 14_groups/rerun_gpu.py, which reproduced the originals bit for bit), plus the false_0 baseline runs already stored.
3 P1/P2 five false titles.report: recovery averaged over the five false titles (primary), per-title spread, and the numerator / denominator split by group (as 391_groups/reports/e1_num_den.md).
3 P1/P2 five false titles.hard check: the false_0 arm reproduces the published P1/P2 recovery values.

4 E4b and all-token probe minus five fal.GPU step: prompt-only forward for all 9,108 papers with false_1..false_4 titles, storing the title-last residual (and ':' residual) at the E4b layers (16, 24, 32, 40, 44, 48, 52, 56, 60), exactly as Stage 11 titlepos stored true / false_0.
4 E4b and all-token probe minus five fal.probe: unchanged fit (trained on true-title residuals as E4b and addendum 9); spec = probe(true) - mean over k of probe(false_k).
4 E4b and all-token probe minus five fal.title-reuse exclusion: primary: a paper is dropped when ANY of its five donor titles is a training-fold paper (5-donor rule). If fewer than 1,000 target + control papers remain, a second version that applies the exclusion to false_0 only is reported side by side (user rule).
4 E4b and all-token probe minus five fal.report: E4b first token and all addendum-9 roles, all layers; the addendum-9 primary contrasts (surname_first > 0 and surname_first - initial at L40); target - control within bin; the two permutation controls.
4 E4b and all-token probe minus five fal.hard check: the false_0 arm of the new residuals reproduces the stored Stage 11 titlepos false_0 residuals (relative norm difference <= 0.05) and the published E4b L40 +0.061 in the false_0-only version.

not changed: Stage 1-12 frozen scripts are not edited; new code lives in new files (13_stage13/stage13_b1_*.py, 14_groups/*).
